title: Symbolic documentation: the mathematical functions in one short list, with what computes them
author: Claude-JG
description: Maintainer 2026-10-24: the section of exudyn.symbolic lists every function with 'according to specification of C++ std::...', copy-paste text. Write it shorter, and say what computes them: sin, cos, ..., exp, log, pow, atan2 are the portable musl implementation of exudyn.cMath, not std::; sqrt, abs, round, ceil, floor, mod, min, max, isfinite are exact as in C++; asinh, acosh, atanh are the C++ library of the platform. atan2 is missing from the documentation.
releaseNotes: The documentation of exudyn.symbolic lists the mathematical functions in one paragraph and says what computes them: the portable musl implementation of exudyn.cMath (exp, log, pow, the trigonometric and hyperbolic functions, atan2), exactly the C++ library (sqrt, abs, round, ceil, floor, mod, min, max, isfinite), or the C++ library of the platform (asinh, acosh, atanh); atan2 is documented.
